items.title: Counting a Class Vote
items.alt: A teacher guides two children placing round counters into clear tubes beside a Class Vote sign, in black-and-white line art.
items.description: Three tall cylinders stand on the classroom table beside a shallow bowl of counters. The children reach toward separate tubes as the bespectacled teacher watches from behind them.

items.title: Reporting on Election Day
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows a reporter with a microphone beside a camera operator and an Election Day placard.
items.description: The woman stands with both hands around a plain-cube microphone while the bearded operator steadies the large camera. All three tripod legs and the small freestanding sign remain clearly separated beneath the figures.
